verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for users to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Spend-limit `periodicity` (MONTHLY/WEEKLY/DAILY) only sets when a card limit resets. `enableAutoDeletion` is a one-off date-triggered action, not a recurring schedule. Time and day-of-week card restrictions and event-driven webhooks are adjacent controls, not a job scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
